reviews.text: We went because our cat had a knot in his tail, and it was fixed in five minutes! Super professional, incredibly kind, they are very respectful of your animals and explain everything step by step, so if it's your first time, it's all the more pleasant. We'll definitely go back if needed, and our cat is very happy (he almost wants to go again). All this for a very good price!
I would give 10 out of 5 stars if I could. Excellent service, the staff is dedicated.
The best salon in town! Nick is super calm and everything is done gently. It's my new go-to place for the lovely Juni, who's a bit grumpy ;)

If I could give a million stars, I would! I’m relatively new to Montreal and have been on the search for a good grooming salon that can work with my cat, as she’s very anxious. All I can say is that I’ve struck gold!

The people here are so welcoming and amazing at what they do. They not only educate you on proper feline care, but they also treat your babies as if they were their own.

Once again, I’d like to say thank you to the exceptional staff and for all that you guys do. I appreciate it dearly.

With love,
Daisy 🐾 & Jana
Very good service
I wish I could give them more than 5 stars. My cat was very matted due to him being in the sink and they took care of him in under 30 minutes.

It was my first time to go for grooming my cat. But I love it. I love the place their environment. They are very friendly and welcoming. My cat liked them. In the beginning I was worried that how long I should put him there and when they told me you can stay with him while they’re cutting his hair, it made me so happy and relieved. We had great time. I will go again for sure
Fantastic staff who were so calming and caring for my anxious cat. He was  done in 18 minutes!
A very caring person with a natural gift. I highly recommend them!
They were fantastic with my very anxious cat. They were very professional and patient. Very affordable prices too. I'll definitely get my cat groomed there from now on 💜

Truly an excellent experience. I brought my elderly aunt's long-haired rascal to be shaved because he'd built up some knots, and while she was doubtful anyone would be able to shave him without earning a few battle scars, I'm happy to say I've never seen him so well behaved.

From the moment we had him out of the crate, they were attentive to his needs and kept a watchful eye on him throughout the whole process. His nails were trimmed in seconds (a harrowing process requiring two people, lots of hissing, and plenty of growling at home) and he didn't make a peep. Shaving him was almost as simple and straightforward. He got slightly uppity when they got to his tail, but again, the staff knew exactly how to handle him, calming him down while they wrapped up the work quickly and efficiently.

I will absolutely be booking future appointments when the little guy needs it, and I highly recommend Felinus to anyone looking for a place where the staff are warm, professional, and clearly know what they're doing.
Very friendly and helpful staff.
I discovered Felinus for the first time today; the young man is very helpful and kind. I will definitely be back.
Excellent service! 5/5 recommended

Our handsome Caramiel frequented Felinus for many years. Even though he didn't enjoy having his beautiful orange fur shaved, he always received outstanding service at Anne-Marie's. Thank you for everything!

Omg I am blown away for real. I have taken my long haired cat 🐈 to 2 groomers and what a disaster they were . The first made her stink to high heaven for days . I tried to wash the stink and omg my place stank like an old lady wearing a bottle of gross stinky 😐 perfume . The 2nd place just lied to take more money saying they washed her and she was calm when just 1 paw 🐾 in water and she will scratch someone's eyes 👀 out .  The charges were $100 and over for stinky gross and lies plus yoi cant stay with your cat they do not permit it and many reviews are of pets coming out different in character or scared (not good at all ) .
THIS PLACE floored me .  The staff is beyond incredible 😲.  The woman super amazing said I sit on the bench across from the table . She said there the owners stay with them to keep them calm ...WHAT !? 🤯.   Scut my cats 🐈 nails 💅  she brushed her head to tail without issues taking out knots 🪢.  She was so thorough and patient . She understood how I needed bum and legs shaved for cleanliness . I am so beyond words. The price as well though she said it goes by the work I was shocked at the price how affordable it was. My cat 🐈 Frosty came home 🏡  to get out of her backpack 🎒  and just chill on the floor no hiding no grudge at me just so calm and chill.  I seriously would recommend this place to EVERY cat owner and WILL be getting their name out 100% to everyone . I have no words but thank you so so so much 💗 for I was so scared of taking her anywhere anymore. This place is my #1 and Frosty will forever be going there no questions hands down the best place I promise you . If you love ypur cat 🐈 take them to this place ♥️ ❤️ 😄 ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ they get more then 5 stars 🌟 in my book 📖

Nick is the best. Very professional, skilled and quick. Most importantly has a very calm energy that keeps my anxious rescue relaxed. 20mins from welcome to shave, claw clipping, full brush out (on a big thick furred beast), face cleaning and payment. Always impressed with the service here. Excellent value for price as well. Thank you Nick, Bruce is happy. So am I.
Amazing cat grooming service. Very patient and informative, and our cat just melted to her touch. Highly recommended.
Excellent service at Felinus Grooming!! It was my cat's first time, and it went wonderfully! The prices are more than reasonable. I recommend them 100%!

I have gone there for full shaving for an elderly cat who quit grooming and a brushing and a "sanitary groom" for younger cats who just have a lot of fur, and I couldn't be happier with the service provided. A great place for cats
A first for my long-haired grey cat with lots of "mats" of fur...we immediately felt very comfortable at Felinus...Great result, no nervousness for Grizzly the cat...I'll be back.
Lovely and warm staff. My cat feels safe and at ease and leaves with the cutest look. I have been a loyal customer for more than three years and I highly recommend.
A wonderful experience for our cat. The owner is incredibly gentle and kind; she takes her time and never rushes. I highly recommend her!
Excellent service, fast, affordable and tailored to the needs of cats.

We've been taking our Persian cat to Felinus for about ten years now and we LOVE them. Our cat is difficult and a bit of a handful during grooming, but they know exactly how to handle her :) We moved to the Eastern Townships and we still make the trip to get there; the service is truly unbeatable ☺️❤️

Fantastic!!!!! They know cats well, are super polite and professional!!! The reviews were right!! 5 stars, 100% deserved. My baby came out with a ridiculous (and hilarious) haircut but no pain and minimal stress.
Very friend staff.

Best Cat groomers in town. MarieAnne and Nick handled my spicy , long haired , angry cat like pros , with ease and comfort. My cat had a lot of matts and they gave her a clean lion cut in less than 30 mins, no fuss. I highly recommend Felinus, they're very experienced and it shows.

I'm so glad I found Felinus Grooming Inc.! They took wonderful care of my cat Uma. The groomer is very skilled—she trimmed Uma's nails and groomed her while keeping her very comfortable the whole time. I love that this salon is exclusively for cats. The price was reasonable and the quality of service was excellent. The staff is professional, kind, and very attentive. I'll be back soon. Thank you for making Uma look so beautiful—you're amazing!

I’m so grateful for this place because I can bring my cat there with zero worries. Anne-Marie is truly amazing so gentle, loving, and professional, and she did such a beautiful job grooming my cat. It was honestly the best grooming experience we’ve had. The staff are also very kind, and the place feels clean, cozy, and welcoming. This will always be my go-to grooming place. Highly recommend.

Highly recommended.

I’ve been bringing my cat here for years, and I can honestly say the service has been consistently excellent every single time. The staff truly understand cats—their behavior, their needs, and how to keep them calm and comfortable throughout the grooming process. That kind of care and attention makes a huge difference, especially for nervous or sensitive cats.

The quality of grooming is always top-notch. My cat comes home looking great, feeling clean, and never overly stressed. It’s clear that the team takes pride in their work and treats every cat with patience and kindness.

I also really appreciate how reliable they are. Whether it’s scheduling, communication, or the grooming itself. Staff are friendly and cats pros!!

Someone recommended this place to us after we adopted our little Mishka. As first-time pet parents, we were quite nervous about her first grooming appointment since she’s a bit of a feisty cat. But the groomers were incredibly kind, patient, and clearly very experienced. They treated her with so much care and love, which immediately put us at ease.

Since then, we’ve been coming back regularly, and every visit has been just as wonderful. We’re so grateful to have found such a caring team. Highly recommended!
Excellent service, my anxious cat was immediately relaxed.
The best place I've been so far, she loves cats and it shows in her gentle work, attentive and patient! I will definitely go back.
10/10 service and professionalism!!
Friendly staff and patient, job is well done, affordable pricing, the only thing that I would add is parking in the back, thank you for grooming my Murka.
The best in town, not in my neighborhood anymore, but I always go back!

A very pleasant experience. The people are welcoming and calm. I find that when my cats go here to be groomed, they are much less nervous than elsewhere. They have a way of handling cats that puts them at ease. Of course, some cats are more timid than others. But overall, my experience with them has been absolutely five stars.

A wonderful experience getting my two cats shaved. Parking was relatively easy, the place was quiet, and the staff were very competent, gentle, and attentive. I appreciated being able to stay during the session to see how it was going. It was reassuring for both me and the cats. I will definitely be back! Thank you!

Very gentle and patient cat groomer! She encouraged me to bring my super anxious cat unmedicated. I was wary, but I’m happy I listened! She was quick and patient with my cat. I’ll be back when he needs another shave.

I’ve been coming here for years. The staff are the best at what they do. They have all the patience and kindness in the world to deal with my stubborn kitty.

Professional, always on time and they love cats!

Thank you for the years of good service and to many more.

Excellent service, 100% good customer service, and great treatment of my cat.

Thank you, I'm Latina and I highly recommend it.

I'm sold!!!!! Took one of my 3 cats there for a shave and it went very well! My cat is difficult but they were able to shave her without her fussing! The staff is super friendly and you can tell they love what they do and genuinely love animals. I am taking my furbabies there from now on! Im happy 😊 …

My cat does not like to have his nails cut and after struggling for 8 months trying to cut them myself, I decided it was time for a professional! The person at the front was great and I really appreciate them squeezing us in with short notice. Even though he was not a very happy or easy cat, the groomer got his nails done very quickly and they look great. If you are on the fence, it was more than worth the 15$. I will definitely be back!
The groomer was very calm & gentle with our fur baby, timely & efficient. The rates are great-$15 for bikini & bum, pantaloons & tail as well as nail trim included in the grooming. Highly recommend!
Excellent service! Anne-Marie and Nick love animals. Our cats always feel very comfortable with them.
First time trying this place for my cat and definitely not our last! I'm glad everything went smoothly thanks to the friendly patient staff.
Wow, best place for cat grooming! I highly recommend it! Thank you, Felinus!

Absolutely wonderful and exceptionally skilled groomers. So kind, so gentle, really knowledgeable. No judgement. Worth every! single!penny! My cat who is usually a squirmy nervous cat was so calm (still nervous but no hissing no biting no growling)  and trusted the groomer because she knew what she was doing and I really appreciated that I was allowed to sit with my cat and soothe her which kept her even more calm. Truly a wonderful experience. I promise you.

I took my cat Mr Sophie there yesterday for the first time, the groomers were so gentle, caring, friendly and they were super nice. My cat was happy and no complaints from him….super happy with the results and service.

I couldn’t recommend enough. The service is fast and efficient, my cat is always calm with them and they’re so sweet. The claw trimming is also so fast! My baby gets a nice cut and it’s always nice. Thank you!
Very gentle staff with cats, impeccable work, in-depth knowledge of the cat world... Particularly satisfactory service!
These are the best for cat grooming :)

Seriously, the best. Every time I take my cat, they take such good care of her. The woman who grooms her is so kind, and the price is very reasonable! She trims her claws before shaving out any mats and brushing her carefully. She helps calm my cat when she's scared. You can tell she really loves cats and wants what's best for them. They even sell the brush they use, and it's super effective! I highly recommend Felinus!!! Thank you for your wonderful service ❤️

Five-Star Review for Toilettage Felinus

I cannot recommend Toilettage Felinus highly enough! They managed to groom my spicy cat in record time—something I thought was nearly impossible. Not only are they incredibly professional and skilled, but their prices are also very competitive. My cat has never been calmer or cleaner after a grooming session!

I had previously taken her to another groomer in Montreal, and they did a terrible job, leaving her stressed and poorly groomed. The amazing team at Toilettage Felinus not only fixed their mistakes but also soothed my traumatized cat in the process. Their expertise, patience, and genuine care for animals are unmatched.

They’ve earned a customer for life—thank you for being so fantastic at what you do!

This was our first time at Felinus, but certainly not our last! Our cat is usually nervous around people and never lets herself gets groomed, or even touched by strangers (she won’t even let us trim her nails at home). To my surprise, she was very much at ease with the team at Felinus, the whole thing took less than 30 minutes with absolutely zero chaos, it was amazing to see. Will definitely be bringing our cat back there and recommend it to anyone looking for an amazing place to have their kitties pampered. Thank you Felinus team !
Amazying, calm, no judgment.
Incredible place and service, they treat your cat amazingly will always come back

I've been a customer for 4 years, a great experience as always, I highly recommend them!!! Professional service from the whole team
From Papette

I brought my kitten in for her first grooming appointment and overall had a great experience. The staff were very friendly, attentive, and took the time to educate me on proper cat care especially how important fur is for regulating body temperature, which I really appreciated.

She came out with a very clean and neat cut, and I could tell they handled her gently. The only reason I’m giving 3.5 instead of 5 stars is because a small portion of her whiskers on one side were shaved by accident, and while her fur was being cleaned around her nose and eyes, I did notice some verbal reactions like “ew.” I understand grooming can involve some mess, but a more neutral approach would help keep pets (and pet parents) at ease during their visit.

Still, I’m happy with the overall care she received and would consider coming back with a few notes for next time.

Best place ever!! They are so great at what they do, super patient with my grumpy cat and so sweet with my other calm cat... their energy ✨️ is great and cats feels beloved and respect about their temperament... I loved ❤️ to be there and the best thing is that you as an owner can help them to keep your cat little bit more calm being part of the process. Thank you so much guys!! All my respect and love for you!!! We will be clients for ever♡.

A friend recommended this place and I have been going ever since, will not bring my cat anywhere else.
Very patience and excellent service! My cat gets grumpy after awhile and they’re amazing.
Highly recommended!
Very good experience! They are very professional, friendly, and fast. My cat was handled with care. The lion cut looks great. Price is very fair. Highly recommend and will come back!

I highly recommend this place. You can stay there and see how they shave your cat, so you get to see how they treat your cat. Because they are so experienced, it will take around 30mins for your cat to be shaved. The owners and staff are super nice.

I've been going there for years. The team is professional and truly attentive to detail.

Furthermore, I started having my cats groomed for the first time when they were 8 or 9 years old. I was apprehensive about how they would react, being older. The team, with their ability to handle my cats effectively while being attentive to my fluffy kitties, managed to transform an activity that caused anxiety for everyone into a recurring and normalized task for both my cats and me 😅

A huge thank you for your professionalism and dedication to your four-legged clients!
Nelly enjoyed her last grooming session on Saturday, May 31, 2025, at Felinus. She passed away on June 7, 2025, seven days later. ♥️
Friendly and professional.
They are the best, super kind and professional. Candy always feels so good after visiting the great team.

I've been doing business with her for over 10 years.
She's incredibly good, loves animals, and gives great advice.
I've referred her to friends and acquaintances several times, and they've all been very satisfied.
She's the best! 🥰
Thank you, my dear, you do a fantastic job.
Miss Perdue

🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛🐈‍⬛
Best place for cats, no doubt

This is the third year we've brought my cat here for a spring shave. He does NOT allow us to handle him for any grooming but behaves like an angel for the staff here. They are so kind and gentle with him, and do an amazing job. He's so relaxed at the end he doesn't even cry in his crate all the way home, like he usually does in the car. Absolutely go here if you need grooming services for your cat.
I take my two maincoon boys there all the time. Excellent service, great pricing!

I've been going to Felinus for my cat Biscotte for several years now, and I'm always very satisfied with their services!
The staff are friendly, professional, and they handle my cat gently during grooming. My cat has long fur and gets tangled easily. The work is always done well, and my cat is truly happy after her grooming session 😻
Thank you to the team! I recommend them to all cat owners!
Professional service and you can stay with your cat during the service. They gave me great advice and my Fuzzy is absolutely gorgeous!!! Thank you

I am relieved that I have finally found the right groomers .  My cat has allergies and she is super reactive but it was the best experience .  Extremly professional.  I really enjoyed being able to be there when Mimine is getting groomed- also the 1st time I was here they informed me that I should let her hair grow out - due to undercoat not growing back- so technically they lost $ with me but thats why I know they really do care for my baby!  Very thankful

It was our first time at this grooming salon, and we were delighted with their service, kindness, gentleness, and expertise.

We went with our 11-year-old cat, who isn't always easy to handle. However, everything went smoothly, and our cat clearly enjoyed the experience at this salon.
First time for my cat, and everything went perfectly. She's professional, calm, and very experienced. I'll definitely be back!

Genghis Khan absolutely loved his experience!
They were very gentle and loving towards him and a great hair cut too, thank you so much!
Best place for your cats. We were worried since it was going to first time for cats in Montreal. But it was just great. Highly advised

i researched places closer to me and read other reviews and in the end i was willing to hop on the metro and try this place - the reviews were so overwhelmingly positive. i like to go to new places and meet new faces in person to get a feel for the place and face and i felt good about booking my cat's first butt shave here. they handled my cat with care and respect and i think i was more nervous about it all than my cat! so they were patient with me too. 10/10 i would recommend and come again

Amazing professional service! Our 16 years old cat accumulated so much matted fur lately as I was unable to keep up with the grooming for her this year. We brought her to the shop and the 2 ladies did an amazing job to help my cat removed all those painful mats. Our cat is a very dominating, unfriendly cat to the strangers, but they were in control the whole time yet still super gentle and fast :)
Simply the best 😻 …

What a great experience! You can tell that the owner truly cares about cats and what she does. My cats were relaxed and well taken care of. I highly recommend this wonderful groomer and we will be back! Cheers!
Really quick and amazing service! would definitely recommend
I love it!
